basis: root cause records PTFE packing worn, hardened or seized against a moving element (valve stem, rotating drum gland, compressor rod); YD-2301 gland rows and KC-4501 rod packing are the same wear-out mechanism of a PTFE dynamic seal. Scope: a packing is the static sealing element compressed against a moving surface, so WO-240085 'PTFE piston rings worn beyond limit' (KC-4501 2nd-stage piston and rider rings, where the PTFE ring is the moving element running on the cylinder bore) is deliberately out of this family and belongs to no family; it is a wear-out of the same material on the same machine and OPL-KC-4501-04 lists it beside WO-240094, so the exclusion is stated rather than left to be inferred (PS-V8)

member_basis.WO-240028: packing: PTFE 4526L discharge gland packing worn beyond service limit (YD-2301)
member_basis.WO-240029: packing: PTFE 4505L feed-end gland packing hardened and worn (YD-2301)
member_basis.WO-240094: packing: PTFE pressure packing rings worn at distance piece (KC-4501)
member_basis.WO-240135: packing: stem seized in PTFE packing, over-tightened + fines (LV-6701)
member_basis.WO-240138: packing: PTFE V-ring stem packing worn (LV-6701)

member_basis.WO-240003: misalignment: angular misalignment 0.12 mm/100mm after foundation settlement (GA-1201A)
member_basis.WO-240004: bearing: outer race spalling on DE bearing due to prolonged misalignment (GA-1201A)
member_basis.WO-240007: coupling: Rexnord coupling element cracked from repeated misalignment cycles (GA-1201A)
member_basis.WO-240034: bearing: NDE trunnion support roller bearing worn/spalled (YD-2301)
member_basis.WO-240166: bearing: spherical roller fan bearing worn (CT-7801)

basis: root cause records the lubrication supply itself as the failed item: a starved or restricted oil passage or a failed lube oil pump and relief setting, with the bearing named as the location rather than the mechanism. WO-240164 (degraded oil and fouled oil cooler) is not a member: its cooler is a fouled heat-transfer surface, so it stays in 'exchanger fouling and thermal performance' and every row belongs to exactly one family (CR-20)

member_basis.WO-240084: lube oil supply: lube oil pump gears worn and relief valve set low, discharge restored to 2.5 barg (KC-4501)
member_basis.WO-240091: lube oil supply: restricted oil supply groove to No.2 main bearing, passage cleared and clearance checked; the bearing is the location, not the failed item (KC-4501)
